page.layout: One column of running text; marginal notes in the left margin ("Halo+" beside the second paragraph, "Halonum pregnostica." beside the fourth). Page number and running head at top; catchword and gathering mark at foot.

main_text.p: Sub stellis illustrioribus, utpote luminaribus, vel directè vel à latere apparent.

Halo+Directè, ut Halo, qui est circulus in nube minus densa & æquabili, circa Solem, Lunam, aut aliam clariorem stellam lucidus, & in extremitate nigricans apparens. A Seneca dicitur Area, à Plinio Corona.

p.i: Quod Halo in medio luminosior, in extremitate nigrior appareat, fit hoc ob radios reflectiores[?], mediam ejus partem fortius illuminantes, & attenuantes: illud fit ob radios obliquiores, & ad illuminandum minus efficaces. Halones sæpius sub Luna, quam Sole conspiciuntur. Nam Sol calore suo adurente facilius dissipat & absumit nubium vapores, quam humidum Lunæ lumen.

main_text.p: Eadem quoq; causa est, quod noctu sæpius, quàm interdiu videantur: die enim splendente Sole: calor est intensior[?], præsertim æstate, nocte vero remissior.
Autumno creberrimè cernuntur, quia calor tunc temporis remissus, vapores dissipare nequit, sed frigus eo tempore moderatum leviter cogit & condensat eosdem.Halonum pregnostica.

page.notes: The left-margin notes are set in italic and small type; "Halo+" is transcribed as printed with its sign. The reading "reflectiores" and "intensior" are doubtful because of the ligatures and the form of the letter after "vin-". The gathering mark at the foot left is partly rubbed and uncertain. The faint text at the bottom of the scan (below the page edge) is show-through and is not transcribed.
